logp.method_description: The partition coefficient log P was determined by the ‘‘shakeflask’’ method. Briefly, equal volumes of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, 0.01 M, pH 7.4) and n-octanol were mixed, shaken together on a lab shaker (IKA KS 130 basic) for 72 and the phases then separated. Then, approx. 1 mg of each metal complex was dissolved in 300 mL of dimethyl sulfoxide with shaking. From these stock solutions, 5 mL were transferred to an Eppendorf tube and mixed with 750 mL of PBS and 750 mL of n-octanol. After shaking for 15 min and centrifugation (5 min, 3000 rpm), the phases were carefully separated, and the contact layer discarded. Then, 500 mL of each sample was diluted with solvent to 1 mL and the absorbance recorded with an UV/Vis spectrometer (Agilent 8453).
